mapper.select:
SELECT f.id as flierId, f.title, f.description, f.cta_link as ctaLink, f.content_link as contentLink, f.likes, f.copies, f.cta_clicks as ctaClicks, b.id as authorBrandId, b.avator as authorAvatar, b.brand_name as authorName, b.customer_id as authorUserId
, fv.has_like as hasLike, fv.has_click_cta as hasClickCta
FROM flier f INNER JOIN brand b ON f.author_brand_id = b.id
LEFT JOIN flier_visitor fv ON fv.flier_id = f.id AND fv.visitor_brand_id = #{visitorBrandId}
WHERE f.id = #{flierId} and f.status = 'normal'
